casing.notes: Every text starts with a capital letter. After the first word, only proper nouns are capitalized. A text that starts with a {placeholder}, a quote, a bracket or a symbol is judged by its first word.

banned.reason: CONTEXT.md names the surface the console windows live on the Stage; 'plane' is only its definition.
The product name is a proper noun. A path (.ralphy/…) or a command (ralphy run) is code and is not copy.

contractions.use: the two full words: do not, it is, you will
contractions.reason: A contraction is harder to read in a second language (ADR-0065 §10). A possessive such as this path's is not a contraction.

verbs.means: The thing leaves the disk and cannot be restored. This includes a worktree (its directory is deleted).
The thing leaves a list. Nothing on the disk changes.

A list or a panel is read again from the daemon.
An open file is read again from the disk, and the copy on screen is replaced.
